moats.claim: An extensible pieces ecosystem and embedded workflow builder can create integration-specific switching costs; connector breadth remains contestable.

productReasons.claim: Compose AI agents, structured Tables and cross-app flows in one automation workspace.
Expose integrations through MCPs and an embedding SDK for product workflows.
Extend the automation catalog with inspectable custom pieces instead of waiting for a connector release.

sponsorship.notes: Corporate sponsorship source checked. No separate corporate sponsor verified; accountable commercial steward included.

requirements.notes: Production service; may be bundled in the documented container stack.
Production setup includes dedicated postgres container for flows/runs/connections.
Documented production Compose queue; Railway page separately allows memory cache.
Separate app/UI and worker containers; scale workers with workload.
Embedded PostgreSQL alternative for personal single-machine use; no scale, cannot migrate this instance to Enterprise.

resources.notes: Official recommended self-host script requires at least2vCPU/4GB; not a universal capacity guarantee.

selfHosting.notes: Production default is PostgreSQL+Redis+app+worker. PGLite/memory route is explicitly hobby-only. Railway optional-memory wording is narrower than recommended production Compose.

options.name: Official self-host setup script
options.notes: Generates configuration/secrets and starts four containers; not browser one-click.

options.name: Railway one-click template
options.notes: Official guide confirms template and automatic PostgreSQL provisioning; provider costs separate.

oneClickInstall.notes: Only verified official deployment options included; one-command installers labelled separately from one-click. Manual Docker Compose alone is not counted as one-click.
